adapterFieldSemantics.adapter: DECLARED_OPERATION_TYPE_ONLY: this field is an operation identity, never proof of a physical Java source path or method.
adapterFieldSemantics.physicalSourceEvidence: The 196-row operation-source-read ledger records current path#method evidence or GAP_ADAPTER_SOURCE_ANCHOR. The future generated operation-source inventory, not this catalogue, is the only machine source-path authority.
adapterFieldSemantics.nonM1CurrentState: All 45 non-M1 declared operation types are explicit GAP_ADAPTER_SOURCE_ANCHOR until a real source path#method exists; a future source inventory/shape row must not admit a synthetic adapter path.

codes.A: one named application REQUIRED transaction origin; edge has none; nested owner work joins REQUIRED
codes.B: one fresh request-local context/auth fact load; reuse its in-memory projection only; no cross-request cache
codes.C: audit owner-local prewrite reads; fold only semantic-equivalent validation; preserve owner recheck/CAS/audit/lock/typed failure/readback
codes.A_NA_PUBLIC_PROTOCOL: NOT_APPLICABLE: §4.1 excludes A; public protocol is already near observed floor
codes.C_NA_WORKSPACE_PROTOCOL: NOT_APPLICABLE: §4.1 selects A+B only; no C may be inferred
codes.C_NA_PLATFORM_PROTOCOL: NOT_APPLICABLE: §4.1 selects A+B only; no C may be inferred
codes.C_LIGHT: light C audit only; preserve public protocol floor
codes.GAP_OPERATION_LEVEL_IDEMPOTENCY_NOT_DECL: SOURCE_GAP: source-reopen adapter/owner before target choice
codes.GAP_OPERATION_LEVEL_READBACK_NOT_DECLARE: SOURCE_GAP: source-reopen adapter/owner before target choice

M1_OWNER.accept: exact tuple/route/edge/adapter; one origin/no edge tx; facts once/request; receipt/readback unchanged
M1_OWNER.red: second origin|edge tx|same-request fact load>1|removed correctness

PLATFORM_OWNER.accept: same plus enabled platform session recheck

WORKSPACE_PROTOCOL.accept: one protocol origin; session-entry/auth facts once; semantics preserved

PLATFORM_PROTOCOL.accept: one protocol origin; platform auth facts once; semantics preserved

PUBLIC_PROTOCOL.floor: preserve observed public floor; receipt/readback source-reopen
PUBLIC_PROTOCOL.accept: C-light audit only; no A/B claim; protocol semantics preserved
